mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduction in blood pressure; chlorthalidone causes volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) which are potentiated by candesartan's effects on the renin-angiotensin system.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and electrolytes regularly; adjust doses as needed; counsel patient on salt intake and dehydration symptoms; this combination is commonly used therapeutically but requires careful monitoring.
